shellCommands.command: find app lib __agent_eval__ -type f | head -50 && echo "---NEXT CONFIG---" && cat next.config.ts

find .next -path '*product*' -name '*.html' 2>/dev/null; echo "--- shell contents ---"; f=$(find .next -path '*product*' -name '*.html' | head -1); grep -o '

[^<]*

' "$f"; echo "--- does shell contain 'in stock'? ---"; grep -c 'in stock' "$f" || echo "0 (correct: streamed later)"; echo "--- fallback present? ---"; grep -o 'Loading inventory[^<]*' "$f"
(PORT=3111 npx next start >/tmp/server.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "server up: %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3111/product

cd /tmp && curl -sN --no-buffer http://localhost:3111/product | while IFS= read -r line; do
  case "$line" in
    *"Premium Widget"*) printf "[%6.3fs] TITLE arrived\n" "$(echo "$(date +%s.%N) - $START" | bc)" ;;
  esac
done 2>/dev/null; echo "(running timed test properly below)"

pkill -f 'next start'; cp /tmp/data.ts.bak lib/data.ts && echo "=== pristine original data.ts + original page.tsx ===" && cat lib/data.ts && npm run build 2>&1 | grep -E 'Error|error|product|✓' | head -20
cp /tmp/page.fixed.tsx app/product/page.tsx && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -12
echo "=== app/product/page.tsx ===" && cat app/product/page.tsx && echo "=== lib/data.ts (unchanged?) ===" && git diff --stat && echo "=== git diff lib/ ===" && git diff lib/ | head
echo "=== lib/data.ts ===" && cat lib/data.ts && echo "=== diff vs HEAD ===" && git diff --stat && echo "=== tsconfig diff (Next-generated) ===" && git diff tsconfig.json
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -10 && pkill -f 'next start' 2>/dev/null; rm -f /tmp/probe.mjs /tmp/page.fixed.tsx /tmp/data.ts.bak; echo "cleaned up"

pgrep -laf 'next-server|next start' || echo "no servers running"; echo "--- prerendered shell ---"; grep -o '

[^<]*

\|Loading inventory[^<]*' .next/server/app/product.html
